nodes.name: Agent Runtime.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node (SYS-004) defining the Agent Runtime bounded context, which provides state persistence, context window assembly, and trade logging infrastructure via the Wake-Execute-Sleep lifecycle. Serves as the lateral memory service consumed by all other systems.
nodes.languageNotes: Ontology-governed system node following dev_graph schema v2.2.0 with canonical_id SYS-004 and relationship sections structured for Neo4j export.

nodes.name: Data Pipeline.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node (SYS-001) defining the Data Pipeline bounded context, responsible for market data ingestion, feature engineering, and deterministic Layer 2 Snapshot assembly — the single source of truth consumed by all downstream trading systems.
nodes.languageNotes: Canonical system node with upstream dependencies on Alpaca, TradingView, and Perplexity external APIs; downstream contract expressed through the Snapshot API (INT-001).

nodes.name: Evaluation Loop.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node (SYS-005) defining the Evaluation Loop bounded context, which closes the feedback loop by scoring trading performance, validating promotion readiness against quantitative thresholds, and managing the system lifecycle state machine.
nodes.languageNotes: Connects Agent Runtime (upstream trade data source) to Supervisor Office (downstream recipient of evaluation scorecards and promotion decisions).

nodes.name: Risk Control.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node (SYS-003) defining the Risk Control bounded context, a separate guardrail enforcement layer that validates every trade request from the Trading Engine before it can reach broker APIs, ensuring hard limits cannot be bypassed by agent logic.
nodes.languageNotes: Explicitly designed as an external validation boundary because the LLM agent cannot self-enforce constraints; sits between the Trading Engine and broker APIs.

nodes.name: Supervisor Office.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node (SYS-006) defining the Supervisor Office bounded context, the meta-governance system that manages upgrade evaluation, treasury budget allocation, team orchestration, and the Office Action Loop state machine governing how the trading system evolves.
nodes.languageNotes: Implements the Syndicate Squad architecture where the supervisor is the product; operates on a longer cadence than the trading pipeline and manages four capabilities (CAP-015 through CAP-018).

nodes.name: Trading Engine.md
nodes.summary: Dev-graph system node (SYS-002) defining the Trading Engine bounded context, the central execution layer that transforms Layer 2 snapshots into trading decisions, routes orders through broker APIs, manages position lifecycle, and enforces stop-loss rules.
nodes.languageNotes: Five active capabilities including the newer Gold Decision Generation (CAP-020) which supersedes the deprecated Signal Generation (CAP-004); interfaces with Data Pipeline, Risk Control, Supervisor Office, Agent Runtime, and broker APIs.
